title: Playing with Blue's band; Fazola's marriage
summary: Substituting for bandleader Lewis, his polish; Irvin Fazola's marriage to Joe Rodas's sister; Two Tonys.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Oh, you see I played with Blue a good while back then. I used to substitute them. He had a fine little band. His theme song was the, I think it was Rhapsody and Blue. You know, just... Mm-hmm. And he had a fine little band. He used to get a lot of work. He was more, you know, polished and polished. He had more education. He was more than a kid than a kid. He seemed like a guy so young too. He had a lot of work. He's got one sister left now. Mm-hmm.
